family: The single total certificate-prefix family defined at every length in proof.md Sections1--2 and family.py. Select the least prime k at least the least positive integer b with b^5>32N^3; put m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)), with the exact exceptional guards and d from proof.md. Read a paid k-bit irreducible-polynomial prefix, reject invalid prefixes, and evaluate the descending-power elementary symmetric payload polynomial of order t with zero padding.
theorem: This one fixed total language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. At every sufficiently large actual integer input length N, all guards pass and C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(4k+8d), where 4k+8d=O(N^(4/5))=o(N). Therefore for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N for every integer N>=N_epsilon in the full Li-Yang B2 model.
